links.outcome: Generalist VE-LLM diagnostic accuracy on real-world ECG images versus expert consensus
links.effect: Overall balanced accuracy 50.1% to 61.8% across generalist models; AF sensitivity ≤11.1%; QTc sensitivity 0%-45.5%; ST deviation sensitivity <25%; Cohen κ ≤0.39.
links.quote: VE-LLMs showed moderate overall performance but mostly low sensitivity and limited agreement with expert ECG interpretation.

links.outcome: Comparison of generalist versus ECG-specialized LLMs on same ECG images
links.effect: Specialized models achieved overall balanced accuracy of 56.5% (ECG-Instruct) and 64.4% (PULSE-7B) versus 50.1%-61.8% for generalist models; PULSE-7B better on rhythm and ectopic beats.
links.quote: Specialized models achieved overall balanced accuracy of 56.5% (ECG-Instruct-Llama-3.2-11B-Vision) and 64.4% (PULSE-7B), with PULSE-7B showing higher task-specific balanced accuracy in rhythm classification and ectopic beats detection (up to 86.3% and 89.2%, respectively).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the diagnostic performance of generalist and specialized vision-language models on de-identified 12-lead ECG images without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
